title: Fish Hunter
description: Aim, fire and catch 27 kinds of sea creatures: bosses, fish tides, bombs and coin showers.

title: Cờ Tướng - Chinese Chess
description: Classic Xiangqi: play online with Elo ranking, invite a friend, or beat the computer at three levels.

title: Minesweeper
description: Classic minesweeper on a 30 x 16 board with 99 mines: tap to open, hold to flag, chord to clear around a number.

title: Caro
description: Five in a row on a 20 x 15 board: play the computer at four levels, or online with friends and in Discord voice channels.

privacy.tableData: It sends your player name and the moves you make; the other players at the table see your name and your moves.

title: Chess 3D
description: Chess in 3D: play a friend on one screen or the machine at three levels, with undo and full rules.

title: Tetra Pick
description: Pick the four bricks that form the shown tetromino, in any rotation, to clear them; empty whole rows to bring new bricks down and crack the locked ones.
